native.contract: Electron before-input allowlist; recorder/editable Markdown/native paste/recent-keyup exceptions and effective platform overrides retained. Accepted action consumes native event before renderer IPC; receiving handler can still no-op. Repeats generally yield/consume without re-dispatch according to the specific native resolver, not a universal DOM rule.

global.contract: Committed renderer state; nonrepeat, unprevented, non-recorder. Special selected-folder/text search precedes editable guard; ordinary handlers skip editable and floating terminal ownership. Plugin definitions may win in app focus. A successful claim prevents default and may show terminal capture notice; callback no-op and action eligibility remain separate.

guest.contract: Local Electron guest forwards an explicit switch/allowlist with owner/page information, not every catalog action. Some routes consume even if renderer missing; most require receiver. Simulator has Darwin+setting gate. Grab has asynchronous editable/selection probe. Streamed remote pages use their own renderer route.

workspace.contract: Mounted active workspace keyboard capture, effective context/client platform and terminal policy. Creation/close/cycles mostly ignore repeat. Floating ownership and terminal L3 close delegation apply. Consuming a chord can precede missing-target/policy no-op.

floating.contract: Open floating panel, owned target and nonrepeat/unprevented input; terminal-first context differs from chrome and app double taps. Index can consume out-of-range; no generic assumption that main workspace handler ran.

editor.contract: Explicit mounted editor listeners use effective registry bindings and component/root scope. Save rejects repeats, find/diff navigation consume repeats without rerunning; review-note consumes only successful callback or existing-draft guard. Monaco built-in shortcuts are not automatically registry overrides.

terminal.contract: Active/owned pane manager and target guards; client OS resolves bindings, PTY-host OS affects input bytes separately. Editable/IME/search ownership precedes dispatch. Most actions nonrepeat; copy/select-all/input-source exceptions below. Pane-scoped preview-terminal commands are deliberately consumed without pane effects.

preview-terminal.contract: Read-only dashboard preview terminal is a distinct selected consumer: copy/select/paste/input-source supported; search/clear/focus/equalize/expand/title/close/split are swallowed to avoid leaking control bytes, with no manager effect.

browser.contract: Active local guest/chrome and streamed remote implementations differ. Page/workspace ownership prevents sibling panes acting. Editable guards are action-specific: reload yields, address/find intentionally handle editable chrome; history has no equivalent editable guard.

explorer.contract: Right sidebar open on explorer/files, no inline rename input or ignored editable target; actual focus inside explorer shell including scrollbar required. Navigation is earlier than delete; no universal repeat guard. Commands prevent default without global stopPropagation.

native-global.assertionBodyAssociation: Resolved action objects name openSettings, toggleWorktreePalette, openQuickOpen and zero-based numbered workspace/tab targets, including non-Mac modifiers.

native-quick-menu.assertionBodyAssociation: Custom quick-menu binding resolves under orca-first but is null under terminal-first.

workspace-create.assertionBodyAssociation: Modal callback receives shortcut telemetry and active Tasks Linear issue only; already-open composer emits no modal call.

dashboard.assertionBodyAssociation: Disabled/settings cases do nothing; popout calls callback; opening drawer also opens left sidebar; closing changes drawer only.

settings-open.assertionBodyAssociation: Opening Settings clears search and sets activeView to settings.

review-menu.assertionBodyAssociation: Unsent comments open source control and create nonce/issuedAt request; sent-only or missing workspace returns false; consume is workspace-qualified.

workspace-delete.assertionBodyAssociation: Hovered Git target forwards execution host and expected instance; folder delete forwards host, clears active only after success, and suppresses duplicate pending requests.

workspace-cycle.assertionBodyAssociation: Both directions wrap, missing active selects directional endpoint, empty list returns null.

workspace-history.assertionBodyAssociation: Back/forward update index without growing history; failed activation preserves index; dead entry is skipped.

floating-create.assertionBodyAssociation: New terminal creates floating/group tab with activate:false then activates it; open Markdown invokes picker; both prevent default.

floating-double-tap.assertionBodyAssociation: First tap unclaimed; completed double tap prevents/stops and creates exactly one floating terminal.

floating-cycle-rename.assertionBodyAssociation: Next-all selects tab-2 and focuses it; rename dispatches tab-1 event without mutating custom title.

floating-noop.assertionBodyAssociation: Out-of-range index is consumed with no activation; absent active tab emits no rename event.

floating-policy.assertionBodyAssociation: Terminal-first numbered tab chords on Darwin/Linux remain unclaimed.

floating-max.assertionBodyAssociation: Custom maximize chord changes rendered bounds to maximum.

floating-empty-close.assertionBodyAssociation: Closing empty floating panel hides it and does not close a terminal tab.

save-fallback.assertionBodyAssociation: Save fallback emits exact normal/floating editor file ID; Tasks view emits no save event.
save-fallback.evidenceLevel: mocked event dispatch; not disk save

find-editor.assertionBodyAssociation: Platform/layout find consumes event and prevents downstream delivery; repeat consumes without a second callback.

review-editor.assertionBodyAssociation: True open callback consumes; false leaves chord unclaimed; repeat does not reopen; mounted draft guard consumes repeat.

diff-nav.assertionBodyAssociation: F7/Shift-F7 call goToDiff(next/previous); repeats consumed without navigation; custom binding and disposal checked.

guest-zoom.assertionBodyAssociation: Guest zoom in/out/reset including repeated keydown sends direction and prevents default.

guest-history.assertionBodyAssociation: Guest back/forward sends corresponding renderer navigation IPC and prevents default.

guest-find.assertionBodyAssociation: Find IPC carries page and registered workspace, or undefined workspace when absent.

guest-menu.assertionBodyAssociation: Custom quick-command menu chord sends expected IPC and prevents default.

guest-delete.assertionBodyAssociation: Delete chord sends renderer delete request and prevents default.

remote-reload.assertionBodyAssociation: Soft and hard chords both call browser.reload, avoid guest key forwarding, and yield in editable address bar.
remote-reload.evidenceLevel: rendered remote pane with RPC mocks

remote-find.assertionBodyAssociation: Find displays unavailable notice and sends neither RPC nor remote keyboard input.
remote-find.evidenceLevel: rendered remote pane with RPC mocks

address-focus.assertionBodyAssociation: IPC and Mac/Linux chords focus address input and select its full value; inactive pane does not steal focus.

same-cycle.assertionBodyAssociation: Forward same-type selects exact split/unified terminal/editor/browser identity; single type returns false.

all-cycle.assertionBodyAssociation: Forward all-types selects editor after terminal and wraps browser to terminal; singleton returns false.

terminal-cycle.assertionBodyAssociation: Forward terminal cycle skips editor and wraps final terminal to first.

recent-cycle.assertionBodyAssociation: MRU switch activates prior browser unified identity; no previous candidate returns false.

held-recent.assertionBodyAssociation: DOM and IPC opening commit selected tab on Control release before terminal keyup receives event; listbox disappears.

reopen.assertionBodyAssociation: Local reopen creates fresh terminal identity with null PTY and preserved cwd/shell/title/color; remote terminal refusal leaves snapshot.

quick-menu.assertionBodyAssociation: Matching chord toggles menu true then false and prevents/stops immediately; repeats/nonmatches do not toggle.

preview-eligible.assertionBodyAssociation: Markdown edit is eligible; diff/unstaged variant is not.

paths.assertionBodyAssociation: Absolute and relative clipboard formatter returns newline-separated paths in supplied order.
paths.evidenceLevel: pure formatter; no clipboard or shortcut dispatch

terminal-select.assertionBodyAssociation: Mac Mod+A and repeat selectAll; Linux/Windows Ctrl+Shift+A selects, bare Ctrl+A yields.

terminal-policy.assertionBodyAssociation: Mac search, clear, close, vertical/horizontal split and next/previous pane produce exact typed actions.

equalize-policy.assertionBodyAssociation: Equalize unassigned is null; custom binding resolves equalizePaneSizes.

title-policy.assertionBodyAssociation: Title actions unassigned are null; customized set/clear resolve; repeated set-title is null.

split-policy.assertionBodyAssociation: Non-Mac Ctrl+D yields; Ctrl+Shift+D splits vertically; Alt+Shift+D horizontally; Mac Alt+Shift+D yields.

split-effect.assertionBodyAssociation: Remote split forwards PTY, direction, source and worktree/tab/leaf with no local manager call; local confirmed cached cwd passed to horizontal split.

terminal-copy.assertionBodyAssociation: Exact selected text written; empty selection skips; failure rejects preserving selection; optional clear happens only after success.

input-source.assertionBodyAssociation: Configured Shift+Space including repeat resolves native input-source; unassigned yields across platforms; alternate Ctrl+Space works.
input-source.evidenceLevel: policy matcher only; not OS switching

dictation-hold.assertionBodyAssociation: Relevant modifier/primary release invokes stop and clears held flag; unrelated release keeps held; physical/logical and Linux release cases.
